title: Why is a tourist spot famous?
titleTranslate: 景点为什么闻名？
text:
Mount Taishan is in Shandong Province.
It's one of the Five Great Mountains in China.
Mount Taishan is famous for its wonderful views: springs, trees, birds, and flowers.
When the sun rises or sets, the sky over the mountain turns orange, and the clouds turn pink and red.
The top of the mountain is a wonderful place to enjoy the views.
Lots of tourists climb Mount Taishan each year for the views.

I'm on Waikiki Beach now.
It's in Hawaii.
The beach has white sand and the sea is amazing!
The water is usually blue and green, but when the sky turns pink, the water turns pink too.
When the sun sets, the water turns yellow, orange, or purple.

There're also many interesting sea animals, such as sea lions, flying fish, and sea horses.

title: Making New Friends at School
titleTranslate: 在学校结交新朋友
text:
Hello, boys and girls!
Do you like to make new friends at school?
Yes?
Here's some of my advice.

First, don't be shy!
Try to talk to all of your classmates.
Smile and say, "Hello!
What's your name?"
If you didn't hear the name clearly, try, "Sorry, can you repeat that for me, please?"
Then give your name and say, "Nice to meet you!"
It's really as simple as that!
It's important to get people's names right.
If you get them wrong, they might feel sad!

Second, ask questions!
Ask about school, sport, music, and more!
As you listen, think of more questions to ask.
So when your classmate stops talking, you can jump in and ask another question!
But remember, you have to be a good listener before you can ask good questions.

Last, don't forget to share!
Tell your classmates something interesting about yourself.
Then your new friends can get to know you too!
Soon enough, you'll be the best of friends!
textTranslate:
同学们，你们好！
你们喜欢在学校结交新朋友吗？
是吗？
下面是我的几点建议。

第一，不要害羞！
试着和所有同学交谈。
微笑着说：“你好！
你叫什么名字？”
如果没有听清名字，可以试着说：“抱歉，请再说一遍好吗？”
然后说出自己的名字，并说：“很高兴认识你！”
事情就是这么简单！
准确记住别人的名字很重要。
如果叫错了名字，他们可能会伤心！

第二，要提出问题！
多询问学校、运动、音乐等方面的问题！
听别人说话时，再想一些可以问的问题。
这样，当同学说完话时，你就可以接着问另一个问题！
但要记住，只有先成为一名 good 倾听者，才能提出好问题。

最后，别忘了分享！
告诉同学们一些关于自己的趣事。
这样，你的新朋友也能更好地了解你！
不久之后，你们就会成为最好的朋友！

title: Nwa
titleTranslate: 恩瓦
text:
Once upon a time, the world was very young and there were no people on the earth.
One day, the goddess Nwa sat by the river.
After washing her face and tidying her hair, she decided to make something special.
She took some clay from the river bank and made a tiny figure like herself.
She put the clay figure on the ground and gave it life.

The clay figure grew up day by day, but it had no one to play with.
Then Nwa made more clay figures: some boys and some girls.
They could run, laugh and play with each other.
As they grew up, they enjoyed a happy life.
textTranslate:
从前，世界还很年轻，地球上没有人类。
一天，女神恩瓦坐在河边。
洗过脸、梳理好头发后，她决定制作一件特别的东西。
她从河岸取了一些黏土，捏了一个像自己一样的小人儿。
她把黏土小人放在地上，赋予了它生命。

黏土小人一天天长大，却没有人和他一起玩耍。
于是，恩瓦又制作了更多黏土小人：有些是男孩，有些是女孩。
他们可以奔跑、欢笑，还能一起玩耍。
随着他们长大，他们过着快乐的生活。

title: Unit 2 · Family Ties in Names
titleTranslate: 第二单元 · 名字中的亲情
text:
Hello!
My name is Alan, and I'm from the UK.
Here most people have a first, middle, and last name.
My full name is Alan Luke Wood.
Alan is my first name, Luke is my middle name, and Wood is my last name.
We also call the last name a "family name" or "surname".

My grandfather also has three names.
His full name is George Charles Wood.
My father's name is the same as my grandfather's.
Can you guess why?
It shows great respect for my grandfather.
People call my father George Charles Wood Junior, and they call my grandfather George Charles Wood Senior.

My mother's name was Linda Grant, but now her name is Linda Wood.
Why is that?
Because in the UK, a woman often changes her family name to her husband's family name.
Sometimes, however, the woman's last name and the man's last name are joined together.
This allows both family names to live on.
textTranslate:
你好！
我叫艾伦，来自英国。
在这里，大多数人都有名、中间名和姓。
我的全名是艾伦·卢克·伍德。
艾伦是我的名，卢克是我的中间名，伍德是我的姓。
我们也把姓称为“家族名”或“姓氏”。

我的祖父也有三个名字。
他的全名是乔治·查尔斯·伍德。
我父亲的名字和我祖父的名字相同。
你能猜到为什么吗？
这样做表示对祖父的尊敬。
人们称我父亲为“小乔治·查尔斯·伍德”，称我祖父为“老乔治·查尔斯·伍德”。

我母亲原来名叫琳达·格兰特，但现在她叫琳达·伍德。
为什么会这样呢？
因为在英国，女子通常会随夫姓，改用丈夫的姓氏。
不过，有时也会把女子的姓和男子的姓组合在一起。
这样，两个家族的姓都能得以延续。

title: Unit 2 · Mulan
titleTranslate: 第二单元 · 花木兰
text:
Mulan, the eldest daughter in her family, loved her family very much.
When she was young, her dad taught her how to fight and be strong.

One day, the emperor made a rule that every family had to send at least one boy to be in the army.
But in Mulan's family, her brother was still a little kid and couldn't go, and her father wasn't healthy.

"What can I do to help?"
Mulan thought.
"Well, I know!
I can fight too.
I can go in place of my dad and join the army."

To join the army, Mulan dressed up like a boy.
She was brave on the battlefield for a long, long time.
No one in the army knew she was a girl.
textTranslate:
花木兰是家中长女，非常爱自己的家人。
她小时候，父亲教她习武，让她变得坚强。

一天，皇帝颁布法令，要求每个家庭至少派一名男孩参军。
但花木兰的弟弟还是个小孩子，不能去参军，而她的父亲身体也不健康。

“我能做些什么来帮忙呢？”
花木兰想。
“有了！我知道该怎么做了！
我也会武艺。
我可以代爸爸从军，参军入伍。”

为了参军，花木兰女扮男装。
在战场上，她英勇作战了很长时间。
军中没有人知道她是女子。

title: Unit 3 · My Floating School
titleTranslate: 第三单元 · 我的流动学校
text:
My name is Sadia Khatun.
I'm from Bangladesh.
It's difficult to walk on some roads in the rainy season here.
So how do I go to school?
It's easy!
The school comes to me!
I study on a "floating school".

My floating school is a "school bus" and classroom all in one.
The boat picks me up early in the morning.
Our classroom is on the boat too.
There are several boats on the river at the same time.
Each boat has one teacher and one class.
The teacher teaches us all the subjects.

The boat is long and wide.
We sit at wooden desks.
Big windows bring in lots of sunlight and fresh air.
There's a blackboard at the front.
There's a computer next to it, and it gets its power from the sun.
At the end of the school day, the boat takes me home.

The "floating school" is open in the rainy season.
The boat picks students up in the morning.
There are two teachers on each boat.
Every student on the boat has a computer.
Sadia sleeps on the boat at night.
textTranslate:

那么我是怎么去学校的呢？
很简单！
学校主动来找我！
我在一所“流动学校”学习。

我的流动学校既是一辆“校车”，又是一间教室。
清晨，这艘船来接我。
我们的教室也在船上。
河上同时有好几艘这样的船。
每艘船都有一名老师和一つの班。
老师教我们所有科目。

船又长又宽。
我们坐在木课桌旁。
大窗户让 lots of 阳光和新鲜空气进入船内。53. 大窗户让阳光和新鲜空气大量进入船内。
船的前方有一块黑板。
黑板旁边有一台电脑，它利用太阳能供电。
放学后，船送我回家。

“流动学校”在雨季开课。
早晨，船来接学生。
每艘船上有两名老师。
船上的每名学生都有一台电脑。
萨迪亚夜里睡在船上。

title: Unit 3 · Sima Guang: The Young Hero
titleTranslate: 第三单元 · 司马光：少年英雄
text:
During the Song Dynasty, there lived a clever boy named Sima Guang.
One sunny day, he was having fun with his friends in a beautiful garden.
One boy saw a big water vat.
He tried to climb to the top of it, but he didn't know how much water was in it.
Suddenly, he lost his balance and fell into the water.

The water inside was deep, and the boy could not swim.
He started crying for help.

Just then, Sima Guang found a stone.
He got an idea.
He picked up the stone and hit the vat.
The vat was broken and the water gushed out.
The boy was saved and everyone was no longer worried.
textTranslate:
宋代时，有一个名叫司马光的聪明男孩。
一个阳光明媚的日子，他和朋友们在一个美丽的花园里玩耍。
一个男孩看见了一个大水缸。
他试图爬到水缸顶部，但不知道缸里有多少水。
突然，他失去平衡，掉进了水里。

缸里的水很深，而男孩不会游泳。
他开始大声呼救。

就在这时，司马光发现了一块石头。
他有了一个主意。
他捡起石头，用力砸向水缸。
水缸被砸破，水一下子涌了出来。
男孩得救了，大家都不再担心。

title: Unit 4 · Cao Chong: A Smart Boy
titleTranslate: 第四单元 · 曹冲：聪明的孩子
text:
When Cao Chong was five or six years old, his father, Cao Cao, received a gift—an elephant.
Cao Cao wanted to know the elephant's weight, but it wasn't easy to find out.
Just then, Cao Chong got a great idea.
He said to his father, "Give me a big boat and lots of stones.
I can weigh the elephant.
First, lead the elephant onto the boat.
When the boat starts to sink a bit, draw a line on the side to show the water level.
Next, lead the elephant off the boat.
Then, put the stones on the boat until the water reaches the line.
Finally, weigh the stones.
This way, we'll know the elephant's weight."
textTranslate:
曹冲五六岁时，他的父亲曹操收到了一份礼物——一头大象。
曹操想知道大象有多重，但很难弄清楚。
就在这时，曹冲想出了一个绝妙的主意。
他对父亲说：“给我一条大船和许多石头。
我能称出这头大象的重量。
首先，把大象赶上船。
当船开始下沉一点时，在船舷上画一条线，标明水位。
接下来，把大象赶上岸。
然后，把石头搬上船，直到水面上升到那条线为止。
最后，称出这些石头的重量。
这样，我们就知道大象有多重了。”

title: Unit 5 · Alice's Vlog: My Drama Club
titleTranslate: 第五单元 · 艾丽的视频博客：我的戏剧社团
text:
This is Mr Ford, our drama teacher.
Mr Ford is very nice, and he always has great ideas.
He helps me so much!

My parents often come to our shows.
They record the shows, and we watch them on TV later.
Here's a clip from our last show.
That's me with the blonde hair!
I look cute, don't I?

The drama club can be hard when I have to remember a lot of lines, but it helps me to understand a lot more about the plays.
I am usually very shy, but when I am in a play, I no longer feel afraid.
Now I'm brave enough to talk, and even sing, in front of lots of people.
textTranslate:
这是我们的戏剧老师福特先生。
福特先生非常和蔼，而且总是有绝妙的主意。
他帮了我很多！

我的父母经常来观看我们的演出。
他们会把演出录下来，我们以后在电视上观看。
这是我们上次演出的一段录像。
那个金发的就是我！
我很可爱，不是吗？

当我需要记住许多台词时，戏剧社的活动会很难，但这段经历帮助我更深入地理解这些戏剧。
我通常非常害羞，但参加演出时，我就再也不害怕了。
现在我已经勇敢到可以在许多人面前说话，甚至唱歌。

title: Unit 5 · China Enters Space Club
titleTranslate: 第五单元 · 中国加入航天俱乐部
text:
On 24th April 1970, China launched its very first satellite, Dongfanghong-1!
China became the fifth country in the world to have its own satellites in space.

People were so excited when they heard the news.
They looked up at the night sky to see Dongfanghong-1.
The satellite stayed up there for 28 days, and collected lots of important information for scientists to research.

Zhou Zhicheng was just a 7-year-old boy when Dongfanghong-1 was launched.
He remembered, "I can hear the song The East Is Red on the radio.
When Dongfanghong-1 flew over China, my parents and grandparents were very happy."
As he grew older, Zhou Zhicheng followed in the footsteps of those who worked on Dongfanghong-1.
He became a scientist and even joined the team which researched Dongfanghong-5.
textTranslate:
1970年4月24日，中国发射了第一颗人造卫星“东方红一号”！
中国成为世界上第五个拥有自己人造卫星的国家。

人们听到这个消息时都非常激动。
他们抬头望着夜空，寻找“东方红一号”。
这颗卫星在太空中运行了28天，收集了大量重要信息，供科学家研究。

“东方红一号”发射时，周志成只是一个7岁的男孩。
他记得自己曾说过：“我能在收音机里听到《东方红》的歌曲。
‘东方红一号’飞越中国上空时，我的父母和祖父母都非常高兴。”
随着年龄增长，周志成追随了那些参与“东方红一号”研制的人们的足迹。
他成为了一名科学家，还加入了研究“东方红五号”的团队。

title: Unit 6 · The World's Longest Rivers
titleTranslate: 第六单元 · 世界最长的河流
text:
The Yellow River is one of the longest rivers in the world.
It's about 5,464 kilometers long and flows into the Bohai Sea.
It's the second longest river in China.
It is called "Mother River" of China because it brought yellow silt from the mountains, creating fertile land for farming.

The Nile River is the longest river in the world.
It has a length of about 6,671 kilometers and enters the Mediterranean Sea.
Many people live along the banks of the Nile River.
It's also one of the most famous rivers in the world.

The Amazon River is the second longest river in the world.
It runs about 6,480 kilometers to the Atlantic Ocean.
Its waters feed the world's largest tropical rainforest, which is full of monkeys, birds, and giant fish.

The Yellow River is the longest river in the world.
The Yellow River is called "Mother River" of China.
The Nile River is thought to be longer than the Amazon River.
The Nile River is the second longest river in the world.
The Amazon Rainforest is the largest tropical rainforest.
textTranslate:
黄河是世界上最长的河流之一。
黄河全长约5,464千米，注入渤海。
它是中国第二长的河流。
黄河被称为中国的母亲河，因为它把山地中的黄色泥沙带到下游，形成了适合耕种的肥沃土地。

尼罗河是世界上最长的河流。
尼罗河全长约6,671千米，注入地中海。
许多people生活在尼罗河沿岸。
它也是世界上最著名的河流之一。

亚马孙河是世界上最长的第二长河。
它全长约6,480千米，流入大西洋。
亚马孙河的河水滋养着世界上最大的热带雨林，那里有各种各样的猴子、鸟类和巨型鱼类。

黄河是世界上最长的河流。
黄河被称为中国的母亲河。
人们认为尼罗河比亚马孙河更长。
尼罗河是世界上最长的第二长河。
亚马孙雨林是最大的热带雨林。

title: Unit 6 · The Grand Canal: A Marvel of China
titleTranslate: 第六单元 · 京杭大运河：中国的奇迹
text:
China has a long history of canals.
The people living along these canals are very proud of them.
One of the most famous is the Beijing-Hangzhou Canal.
It's one of the longest and the oldest canals in the world, and still used.
It runs from Beijing to Hangzhou.

It connects five big river systems in China, including the Changjiang River Basin and the Yellow River Basin.
For thousands of years, it helped people move food, silk, and other goods.
Even now, boats carry things like coal and wood along it.
The Grand Canal is like a "living bridge" .
It shows how clever and hard-working Chinese people are!
textTranslate:
中国有悠久的运河历史。
居住在这些运河沿岸的人民为它们感到自豪。
最著名的运河之一是京杭大运河。
它是世界上最长、最古老的运河之一，至今仍在使用。
它从北京延伸到杭州。

它连接了中国五大河流系统，包括长江流域和黄河流域。
数千年来，它帮助人们运送粮食、丝绸和其他货物。
即使如今，船只仍沿着运河运输煤炭、木材等物品。
大运河就像一座“生命之桥”。
它展现了中国人民多么聪明和勤劳！
